uz.title: Shakl, tuzilish va ma’no (Form, Structure, and Sense)
uz.summary: Ega va kesim moslashuvi, olmosh va u almashtirgan ot, fe’l zamoni va shakli, ko‘plik va egalik (apostrof) hamda aniqlovchining to‘g‘ri joylashuvi — variantlarda bitta so‘zning turli shakllari berilgan grammatika savollari uchun ixcham qoidalar kitobi.

sections.heading: Qoidalar kitobi (1-qism): asosiy qoidalar
sections.body:
Bu savollarda variantlar bitta so‘zning turli shakllaridan iborat bo‘ladi: *is / are / were*, *its / their*, *scientist's / scientists'*. Vazifangiz — gapning qolgan qismiga grammatik va mantiqiy jihatdan mos shaklni tanlash. Quyidagi misollarda muhim so‘zlarning tagiga chizilgan.

**1-qoida. Ega va kesim moslashuvi.** Kesim haqiqiy egaga moslashadi, unga eng yaqin turgan otga emas. *of…, with…, in…* kabi predlogli iboralarni va vergul bilan ajratilgan qismlarni xayolan o‘chiring: *The __list__ of supplies __is__ long.* (*supplies are* emas). *The __paintings__ in the old hall __were__ restored.* *And* bilan bog‘langan ega — ko‘plik: *The __map and the compass are__ missing.* *Each, every, one of, either, neither* — birlik: *One of the samples __was__ damaged.*

**2-qoida. Olmosh va u almashtirgan ot (pronoun–antecedent agreement).** Olmosh soni u almashtirgan otga mos bo‘lishi kerak: *The __company__ announced __its__ new policy.* (kompaniya — birlik, *their* emas). *The __researchers__ published __their__ results.* Avval olmosh kimni yoki nimani almashtirayotganini toping.

**3-qoida. Fe’l zamoni va shakli.** Zamon matndagi vaqt ko‘rsatkichlariga mos bo‘lishi kerak: *in 1920* — o‘tgan zamon, *currently* — hozirgi zamon, *since 2015* — *has / have* + III shakl. O‘tmishdagi ikki voqeadan avvalroq sodir bo‘lgani uchun *had* + III shakl ishlatiladi: *By the time the rescuers arrived, the storm __had passed__.* III shakl (past participle) to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin: *had __begun__* (*had began* emas), *has __written__*.

**4-qoida. Gapda asosiy fe’l bo‘lishi shart.** *-ing* yoki *to* + fe’l shakli yolg‘iz o‘zi kesim bo‘la olmaydi: ✗ *The researchers analyzing the data.* ✓ *The researchers __analyzed__ the data.*

**5-qoida. Ko‘plik va egalik (apostrof).** Oddiy ko‘plik — apostrofsiz: *two __scientists__*. Birlikdagi egalik — *'s*: *the __scientist's__ notes* (bitta olim). Ko‘plikdagi egalik — *s'*: *the __scientists'__ notes* (bir necha olim). -s bilan tugamaydigan ko‘plik — *'s*: *the __children's__ books*. Olmoshlarning egalik shaklida apostrof yo‘q: *its, their, whose*; *it's* = *it is*, *they're* = *they are*, *who's* = *who is*.

**6-qoida. Aniqlovchining joylashuvi (modifiers).** Gap boshidagi, vergul bilan tugaydigan ibora verguldan keyingi birinchi otni tasvirlaydi: ✗ *Hiking up the trail, __the view__ was stunning.* (manzara yo‘l yurmaydi) ✓ *Hiking up the trail, __we__ saw a stunning view.*

sections.heading: Savolni qanday tanib olasiz
items: Savol so‘zi Boundaries bilan bir xil: *“Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?”* Farq variantlarda.
**Fe’l shakllari:** *is / are / was / have been* yoki *began / had begun / beginning* — moslashuv yoki zamon savoli.
**Olmoshlar:** *it / they*, *its / their / it's / they're* — olmosh moslashuvi yoki egalik.
**Bir ot, to‘rt shakl:** *tortoise's / tortoises / tortoises'* — ko‘plik va egalik.
**Butun gap qismi almashadi:** gap *Having tracked…,* yoki *Known for…,* kabi kirish iborasi bilan boshlanadi va variantlarda harakatni kim bajargani turlicha — aniqlovchining joylashuvi savoli.

sections.heading: Ishlash usuli: qadamma-qadam
steps: **Variantlarni solishtiring: nima o‘zgaryapti?** Fe’l, olmosh, apostrof yoki gap tartibi — shu sizga qaysi qoida tekshirilayotganini aytadi.

**Fe’l bo‘lsa — haqiqiy egani toping.** Predlogli iboralarni (*of the…, in the…*) va qo‘shimcha qismlarni xayolan o‘chiring. “Bu ishni kim yoki nima qiladi?” deb so‘rang, keyin birlik yoki ko‘plikni aniqlang.
**Zamonni kontekstdan aniqlang.** Oldingi va keyingi gaplardagi fe’llarga hamda *in 1890, today, since, by the time* kabi vaqt ko‘rsatkichlariga qarang.
**Olmosh bo‘lsa — u almashtirgan otni toping** va sonini (birlik yoki ko‘plik) solishtiring. *Company, team, city, species* — birlik, demak *its*.
**Apostrof bo‘lsa, ikki savol bering:** (1) birlikmi yoki ko‘plikmi? (2) biror narsaga egalik qilyaptimi? *of* bilan qayta aytib ko‘ring: *the burrows of the tortoises* → *the tortoises' burrows*.
**Kirish iborasi bo‘lsa** — undagi harakatni kim bajarganini aniqlang va verguldan keyin aynan shu shaxs yoki narsa kelgan variantni tanlang.
**Gapni tanlangan variant bilan to‘liq o‘qing:** asosiy fe’l bormi, zamon izchilmi?

example.passage: The collection of hand-painted ceramic tiles that once decorated the walls of the old caravanserai ______ now displayed in the regional history museum.
example.problem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
solution: Variantlar — fe’l shakllari, demak ega va kesim moslashuvini hamda zamonni tekshiramiz.

Haqiqiy egani topamiz: *of hand-painted ceramic tiles* (predlogli ibora) va *that once decorated the walls of the old caravanserai* (aniqlovchi qism) ni xayolan o‘chirsak, *The collection… now displayed* qoladi. Ega — *collection*, birlikda.
*now* so‘zi hozirgi zamonni ko‘rsatadi. Birlik + hozirgi zamon = *is* — **B**.
**A** (*are*) va **D** (*were*) — ko‘plik shakllari: kesim yaqin turgan *tiles* yoki *walls* ga moslashtirilgan. **D** bundan tashqari o‘tgan zamonda, bu *now* ga zid.
**C** (*have been*) — ko‘plik shakli (birlik uchun *has been* bo‘lardi), shuning uchun egaga mos emas.

example.passage: Biologist Kamila Usmonova placed small cameras near the burrows of several desert tortoises. The footage showed that the ______ stayed much cooler than the sand surface during the hottest hours of the day.
example.problem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
solution: Variantlarda ikki so‘z — *tortoise* va *burrow* — turli ko‘plik va egalik shakllarida. Har bir so‘zni alohida tekshiramiz.
*Tortoise*: birinchi gapda *several desert tortoises* — bir nechta toshbaqa, ya’ni ko‘plik. Inlar ularga tegishli (*the burrows of the tortoises*), demak ko‘plikdagi egalik kerak: *tortoises'*.
*Burrow*: inlar hech narsaga egalik qilmaydi — ular gapning egasi va ular bir nechta. Demak oddiy ko‘plik: *burrows*. To‘g‘ri javob — **C**: *tortoises' burrows*.
**A** (*tortoise's burrows*) — birlikdagi egalik: bitta toshbaqa haqida gapiradi, matnda esa bir nechta toshbaqa bor.
**B** (*tortoises burrow's*) — egalik belgisi noto‘g‘ri so‘zda: toshbaqalarda apostrof yo‘q, *burrow's* esa inning nimagadir egaligini bildiradi, lekin undan keyin hech qanday ot yo‘q.
**D** (*tortoises' burrow's*) — birinchi so‘z to‘g‘ri, lekin *burrow's* ortiqcha egalik shakli (va birlikda).

example.passage: Having tracked dozens of steppe eagles with lightweight GPS tags for nearly a decade, ______
example.problem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the eagles' wintering sites were identified by ornithologist Timur Saidov.
the eagles' wintering sites, according to ornithologist Timur Saidov, had been identified.
identifying the eagles' wintering sites was ornithologist Timur Saidov's achievement.
ornithologist Timur Saidov identified the eagles' wintering sites.
solution: Gap *Having tracked…* kirish iborasi bilan boshlanadi. Unda harakat (kuzatish) bor, lekin kim kuzatgani aytilmagan. Qoida: verguldan keyingi birinchi ot (shaxs) aynan shu harakatni bajargan bo‘lishi kerak.
Burgutlarni GPS orqali kim kuzatgan? Ornitolog Timur Saidov. Faqat **D** variantida verguldan keyin darhol *ornithologist Timur Saidov* keladi — to‘g‘ri javob.
**A** — verguldan keyin *the eagles' wintering sites* turibdi: go‘yo qishlash joylari burgutlarni kuzatgandek bo‘lib qoladi. Passiv shakl (*were identified by…*) ko‘pincha shu tuzoqning belgisi.
**B** — yana *wintering sites* birinchi turibdi; *according to…* qismi buni tuzatmaydi.
**C** — birinchi turgan so‘z *identifying* (aniqlash jarayoni); jarayon burgutlarni kuzata olmaydi.
example.answer: D) ornithologist Timur Saidov identified the eagles' wintering sites.

sections.heading: Qoidalar kitobi (2-qism): nimaga e’tibor berish kerak
items: **Ega va kesim orasidagi uzun “to‘siq”:** *The __results__ of the survey, which included more than 2,000 participants, __show__…* — ega *results* (ko‘plik). Vergullar orasidagi qismni o‘chirib o‘qing.
**Teskari tartibli gaplar:** *There __are__ three __reasons__…*, *Among the fossils __were__ two __teeth__.* Bunday gaplarda ega kesimdan **keyin** keladi.
**Either…or, neither…nor:** kesim yaqinroq turgan egaga moslashadi: *Neither the teacher nor the __students were__ ready.*
**Jamlovchi otlar** (*team, committee, family, series, species*) odatda birlik sifatida ishlatiladi: *The __committee has__ approved __its__ report.*
**Olmoshning aniqligi:** gapda ikki ot bo‘lsa va olmosh qaysi biriga tegishli ekani noaniq qolsa, olmosh o‘rniga otning o‘zi ishlatilgan variant to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin.
**Ro‘yxatdagi fe’llar bir xil shaklda (parallel structure):** *The volunteers __collected__, __sorted__, and __labeled__ the seeds.* (*collected, sorting, and labeled* emas).
**Zamon izchilligi:** matndagi boshqa fe’llar va vaqt ko‘rsatkichlariga qarang: *In 1925, the factory __produced__…* — *produces* yoki *will produce* emas.

**Egalik olmoshlari va qisqartmalar:** *its* (uning) — *it's* (it is); *their* (ularning) — *they're* (they are) — *there* (u yerda); *whose* (kimning) — *who's* (who is). Tekshiruv: qisqartmani to‘liq shaklga ochib o‘qing — ma’no buzilsa, u noto‘g‘ri.

sections.heading: Keng tarqalgan xatolar (tuzoq variantlar)
items: **Yaqin otga moslashtirish:** kesimni ega bilan emas, bo‘sh joyga eng yaqin turgan ko‘plikdagi ot bilan moslashtirish (Namuna 1 dagi *tiles… are*).
**Birlikdagi otga their olmoshi:** *The organization… their* — og‘zaki nutqda keng tarqalgan, lekin SAT’da birlikdagi tashkilot yoki narsa uchun *its* kerak.
**Oddiy ko‘plikka apostrof qo‘yish:** *several scientist's* — egalik bo‘lmasa, apostrof kerak emas: *several scientists*.
**It's va its almashinuvi** — eng mashhur tuzoqlardan biri. *It's* faqat *it is* yoki *it has* ma’nosida.
**Passiv shakldagi “rasmiy” variant:** aniqlovchi savollarida passiv konstruksiya (*…were identified by…*) jiddiy eshitiladi, lekin ko‘pincha kirish iborasini noto‘g‘ri otga bog‘laydi.
**Asosiy fe’lsiz variant:** *-ing* shakli (*analyzing, being*) gapni kesimsiz qoldiradi — bu variant ko‘pincha “uzun va ilmiy” ko‘rinadi.
**Zamon tuzog‘i:** grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, lekin matndagi zamonga zid shakl (masalan, *now* bilan *were*).

sections.heading: Vaqt bo‘yicha maslahat
items: Bu savollar uchun **30–50 soniya** yetarli. Reading and Writing’da o‘rtacha vaqt savol boshiga taxminan 71 soniya — bu yerda kamroq sarflab, vaqtni uzun matnli savollarga qoldiring.
Avval variantlarga qarab, nima o‘zgarayotganini aniqlang — bu qaysi qoidani qo‘llashni darhol aytadi va matnni maqsadli o‘qishga yordam beradi.
Ega uzun bo‘lsa, qoralamaga faqat ega va kesimni yozib ko‘ring: *collection… is*. Shunda xato darhol ko‘rinadi.
Ikki variant orasida qolsangiz, ikkalasini gapga qo‘yib o‘qing va qoidani nomlang (“ega birlikda”, “ko‘plikdagi egalik”) — “qulog‘imga yoqdi” degan sabab yetarli emas.

terms.meaning: olmosh almashtirgan ot: *The city… its* gapida *city*
fe’l zamoni: *past, present, future, present perfect*
gapning asosiy (kesim bo‘la oladigan) fe’li; *-ing* va *to* shakllari bunday emas
“osilib qolgan” aniqlovchi — kirish iborasi noto‘g‘ri otni tasvirlab qoladi
jamlovchi ot: *team, committee, species* — odatda birlik

sections.heading: Javobni tanlashdan oldin tekshiring
items: Variantlarda nima o‘zgarayotganini (fe’l, olmosh, apostrof yoki tartib) aniqladimmi?
Haqiqiy egani yoki olmosh almashtirgan otni topib, birlik yoki ko‘plikni tekshirdimmi?
Zamon matndagi vaqt ko‘rsatkichlariga mosmi?
Kirish iborasidan keyin aynan harakatni bajargan shaxs yoki narsa turibdimi?
